ghost_27.name: Claim-id-order nondeterminism

update_law.away_key: S_ent[k] <- decay_away*S_ent_mem[k]; prune if |.| < prune_eps  (Ghost #23 temporal decoherence)

healing.contrast: alpha_persist=0 (memoryless): tear forgotten in one scene (delta spike, no smoothing)
healing.resolves: Ghost #26: memory lets the EXP-503 restoring force act across scenes (temporal, not just instantaneous)

observables.H_seed: P_yz-invariant structural index over persisted state tuple

[8] amnesiac contrast: alpha_persist=0 -> post-tear excess ~0 next scene (no smoothing)
[9] gate is_manifold_501 admissible throughout tear+heal; persisted B_ent_spectral bounded
